content.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original premium Thanksgiving invitation border: a graceful ring of THREE wide braided willow stems. Lower-left cluster of three small pumpkins (two orange and one ivory). Upper-right ONE large burgundy maple leaf, TWO acorns and THREE sage leaves. Plenty of clear empty center for a greeting. Beautiful professional hand-inked vector artwork with clean black contours and broad smooth two-tone shading, rich warm color, graceful natural forms and an elegant coherent arrangement. No wheat, thin twig tangles, wood texture, grain, scratches or microdetails. All objects complete and well inside a square transparent canvas. No glow, matte, floor/shadow, text or watermarks.
